name: Zuranolone
drug_class: Neuroactive steroid; GABA-A receptor positive allosteric modulator
route_note: Oral capsules once daily in the evening with fat-containing food for a 14-day course.

discovery.note: Designed as an orally bioavailable analogue of the endogenous neurosteroid allopregnanolone, following the IV allopregnanolone formulation brexanolone.

tagline: First oral drug approved for postpartum depression, taken as a two-week course
summary: Zuranolone is an oral neuroactive steroid that positively modulates GABA-A receptors. In 2023 it became the first oral medicine approved specifically for postpartum depression, given as a 14-day course; an application for major depressive disorder was not approved.
mechanism: Zuranolone binds a neurosteroid site on GABA-A receptors and enhances chloride currents at both synaptic and extrasynaptic (delta-subunit-containing) receptors, increasing tonic and phasic inhibition.
Allopregnanolone levels rise in pregnancy and fall abruptly after delivery; restoring neurosteroid signalling is proposed to rebalance brain networks implicated in postpartum depression.

history.title: Brexanolone
history.detail: IV allopregnanolone (Zulresso) is approved for postpartum depression, establishing the mechanism.

history.title: Biogen collaboration
history.detail: Biogen and Sage agree to co-develop and co-commercialise zuranolone.

history.title: ROBIN trial
history.detail: The phase 3 ROBIN trial in postpartum depression is published in JAMA Psychiatry.

history.title: SKYLARK
history.detail: The phase 3 SKYLARK trial in postpartum depression is published in the American Journal of Psychiatry.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: In August 2023 the FDA approves Zurzuvae for postpartum depression but issues a complete response letter for MDD.

serious: Impaired ability to drive and CNS depression
safety.boxed_warning: Impaired ability to drive or engage in other potentially hazardous activities; patients should not drive for at least 12 hours after each dose. Suicidal thoughts and behaviours.

facts: Unlike conventional antidepressants it is taken for only 14 days rather than continuously.
